0022600125.text: The Atlanta Hawks (2-1, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East) visit the Houston Rockets (3-0, 1st in the Southwest, 2nd in the West) for their fourth game of the season, with Atlanta coming off a loss and Houston riding a three-game win streak. Atlanta is 2-0 on the road but 0-1 at home, and the Hawks trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 121-114 in Atlanta on October 24, having also lost both meetings in 2025-26. Atlanta will be without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Houston is missing Steven Adams (calf strain) and has Marcus Smart listed as day-to-day with a forearm strain and a game-time decision.
